Do not clarify which format is meant: the agent has to pick.

scenarios.title: Two skills in one task
scenarios.prompt: Add parsePort(text) to src/net.js: it returns an integer from 1 to 65535 and otherwise raises an error in the net area. Follow our conventions.
operatorSteps: Send the prompt once.
Let the session finish its turn.

scenarios.title: Mixed room: Claude and Codex
scenarios.prompt: Room task: add parsePort(text) to src/net.js (integer 1..65535, otherwise a net-area error). Claude writes the code, Codex writes and checks the documentation. Follow our conventions.
operatorSteps: Create the room with the two sessions.
Send the prompt to the lead.
Let both sessions report.

scenarios.title: Personal message between sessions
scenarios.prompt: Ask the worker (one personal message) to add the changelog entry for the CSV export of reports, issue 4711.
operatorSteps: Send the prompt to the lead only.
Do not message the worker yourself.

scenarios.title: Broadcast to a room
scenarios.prompt: Tell the whole room (one broadcast) that release notes for 1.3.0 are needed; exactly one worker writes them, the others stay quiet.
operatorSteps: Send the prompt to the lead.
Let the room settle; do not reply to individual workers.

scenarios.title: Human corrects the task mid-way
scenarios.prompt: Add a changelog entry for the new CSV export of reports, issue 4711.

followUps.text: Correction: the issue number is 4712, not 4711.

operatorSteps: Send the prompt.
After the first tool call send the correction as a new human message.

scenarios.title: Stop and resume
scenarios.prompt: Add parsePort(text) to src/net.js: it returns an integer from 1 to 65535 and otherwise raises an error in the net area. Follow our conventions.
operatorSteps: Send the prompt.
Press Stop after the first tool call.
Resume the session and send the follow-up.
